app.title: PD
moreWindows.title: Select Window
menu.ws.autosave.tip: Saves the window layout on exit and restores it on the next start.
menu.ws.escClose.tip: Esc closes the active document window. Esc pressed in a text box or list does not close it.
menu.ws.magnet.tip: Snaps windows to the edges of other windows and of the work area while moving or resizing.
menu.ws.resetMain: Reset Main Window Size and Position
menu.ws.capture.tip: Keeps this program's windows out of screenshots and screen recordings (Windows, Android).
settings.tabClose.auto: Automatic (on hover with a mouse, always with touch)
settings.tabClose.activeAndHover: Active tab always, others on hover
rename.label: New name
layout.name: Layout name
layout.readOnly.tip: Can only be loaded or saved under a new name.
layout.saveAs.tip: Loads the selected item (or keeps the current screen if nothing is selected) and saves it under a new name.
layout.applyTemplate.tip: Keeps the open documents and changes only their arrangement (locked windows stay in place).
layout.err.nameExists: A layout with this name already exists. Use a different name.
layout.err.readOnly: This item is read-only (last session). Save it under a new name.
layout.err.notFound: The item was not found. Refreshing the list.
layout.err.failed: Could not write to storage. Check the log.
layout.backup.title: Full Backup and Restore
layout.backup.title.tip: Backs up settings, the last session and all saved layouts as one bundle. Restoring applies it immediately without a restart.
layout.backup.confirmRestore: Restore everything from '{0}'? The current state is backed up automatically first.
layout.tpl.mdiCascade.desc: Overlaps document windows in a cascade with 30px steps.
layout.tpl.mdiTileV.desc: Places document windows side by side.
layout.tpl.mdiTileH.desc: Stacks document windows top to bottom.
layout.tpl.tabbed.desc: Shows documents as tabs, one at a time.
layout.tpl.focus.desc: Hides all panels and shows documents as wide tabs. Applying another template brings the panels back.
menu.view.uiStyle.disabled.phone: Smartphones use the mobile layout only
titlebar.uiStyle.tip: PC layout: multiple windows (MDI) / Tablet layout: panels and tabs (DOCK) / Mobile layout: bottom tabs and menu (NAV)
titlebar.uiStyle.auto.tip: Picks the PC, Tablet or Mobile layout automatically from the window size
settings.sdiAboveMain: Keep document windows above main window
settings.sdiAboveMain.tip: Keeps standalone (SDI) windows above the main window. Separate from each window's 'Always on top'.
nav.reason.pcTablet: Available in PC and Tablet layouts
busy.name: Working
panel.corner.name: Expand panel
titlestrip.sdi.name: Standalone window
notify.badge.name: New notifications
notify.badge.tip: {0} new notification(s) - click to show the notification panel
settings.window.title: Settings
settings.tabletMode.tip: Replaced by screen layout. Shown only for the old saved value.
settings.fastDocSwitch.tip: Keeps hidden tab documents on screen so switching tabs is faster. Uses a little more memory when many documents are open. Tab keeping applies to tab areas created after the change.
settings.tabHeaderFirst.tip: When you tap a tab, the selected tab is shown first and the document content changes on the next frame. Taps feel faster, but the content changes a moment later. Applies when fast document switching is on.
settings.panelFeature.tip: Turns the panel feature on or off. In Auto it is on only in the PC layout and off in the Tablet and Mobile layouts.
settings.compactWindowKeepsTablet: Keep Tablet layout in narrow windows
settings.compactWindowKeepsTablet.tip: Keeps the Tablet layout even when the window is narrower than 600dp, such as in split screen. Off by default.
settings.busyDelay.tip: The progress indicator appears only when a task takes longer than this time (ms). Prevents flicker on short tasks.
settings.busyMinVisible.tip: Once the progress indicator appears, it stays at least this long (ms).
settings.prewarmViews.tip: After the first screen appears, builds the document views (grid, form, Gantt) once off-screen during idle time so the first open is faster.
settings.gridCompactCells.tip: In tables without vertical lines, draws each cell as a single element so tables open faster. The look stays the same. Applies to tables opened afterwards.
settings.gridDrawnCellText.tip: In tables that draw cells lightly, each cell draws its own text without a separate text element so tables open faster. The look stays the same. Applies to tables opened afterwards.
settings.gridViewPool: Prepare a table view in advance
settings.gridViewPool.tip: During idle time, builds one hidden table view in advance and uses it the next time you open a table. Uses a little more memory.
settings.gridDeferCells.tip: Builds the contents of table cells in columns that are not on screen only when each cell first comes into view, so tables open faster. Applies to tables opened afterwards.
settings.snapEnabled.tip: Drag a window to a screen edge or the layout bar at the top to fit it into a preset zone. Turning this off disables the options below.
settings.snapLayouts: Zone types on the layout bar
settings.snapLayouts.tip: Comma-separated zone types shown on the layout bar. Allowed values: max, half, twothird, thirds, leftsplit, quad.
settings.snapEdgeDistance.tip: While dragging, a window within this distance of an edge snaps to a half or corner zone.
settings.snapBarDelay.tip: How long to hold a dragged window at the top before the layout bar appears. 0 shows it immediately.
settings.snapEdge.tip: Dragging a window to the left or right edge or a corner fits it into a half or quarter zone.
settings.snapTopEdgeMaximize.tip: Dropping a window on the top edge maximizes it to the whole area.
settings.snapKeyboard.tip: Use shortcut keys to fit the active window into a preset zone.
settings.snapFlyout: Show layouts on the maximize button
settings.snapFlyout.tip: Rest the pointer on a window's maximize or restore button to show the layouts, then click a zone to fit the window there. Not shown for touch or the phone and tablet layouts.
settings.snapFlyoutDelay.tip: How long the pointer must rest on the maximize button before the layouts appear. 0 shows them immediately.
settings.snapSdiMode.tip: Chooses who arranges standalone (SDI) windows. The OS method follows the OS look, so its zone types differ from Pd's.
snap.bar.title: Snap layouts
menu.window.snap.tip: Fits the active window into a preset zone.
settings.snapAssist: Snap Assist (pick windows for remaining zones)
settings.snapAssist.tip: After placing a window in a zone, shows a list to pick windows for the remaining zones. Picking one moves on to the next zone; press Esc or click outside to stop and keep only what you picked. Turns off with window snapping.
settings.snapAssistOnEdge: Also show after edge and corner snaps
settings.snapAssistOnEdge.tip: Shows candidates for the remaining zones after dragging a window to a screen edge or corner.
settings.snapAssistThumbnails.tip: Shows a window preview on each candidate card. When off, or when a preview can't be made, only the icon and title are shown.
settings.snapAssistSdiGrace.tip: How long a late deactivation right after the layout picker opens in an SDI window is ignored and the picker is re-activated. Increase it if another app steals focus and the picker closes immediately.
settings.restoreViews.tip: Sets when document contents are built when the last layout is restored. Deferred builds only the visible documents right away and builds hidden ones when you look at them or one at a time during idle time. Immediate builds all of them right away. Applies from the next restore.
favorite.title: Favorites
favorite.limitReached: You can add up to {0} favorites
favorite.unknownScreen: This screen cannot be opened yet: {0}
settings.titleTabDisplay.tip: Choose whether title tabs show the menu icon, the title, or both
settings.titleTabDisplay.title: Title only
settings.menuIcon.tip: Show per-screen icons in the explorer and the mobile menu. Title tabs follow 'Title tab display'
settings.favoriteBar.tip: Show favorite screens as icons on the right side of the title bar
settings.favoritePosition.end: Far right of the title bar
settings.favoriteClick.activateOrOpen: Switch to open window, or open it
settings.busyIcon.tip: Show a spinner in place of the window icon until the content has loaded
settings.moveShadow.tip: Keeping the shadow redraws it while dragging and may slow window movement
settings.switchSources.tip: Plays the switch effect when you change windows this way. Choose the effect in the Design theme tab of the theme editor
settings.switchSources.locked: Locked by your company's design theme policy
